# Test files of xps

`example.xps` and `xps-document-example.xps` are copies of the test files of
iv, in `testdata/gxps` of github.com/kenshaw/iv. iv does not record where
they came from. `example.xps` says that online-convert.com made it, with text
from Wikipedia under CC BY-SA 3.0. Both hold obfuscated fonts, images and a
thumbnail, and `example.xps` holds its page in UTF-16.
